site.title: Astro - Temporary Voice Channels for your Discord!
site.description: Astro is a Discord bot that allows you to create temporary voice channels in your server. Perfect for gaming sessions, study groups, or any temporary voice chat needs!

home.tagline: The most unique and complete discord bot for temporary voice channels and voice roles!

temp_vc.description: Astro generates fully customisable temporary voice channels on prompt and deletes them when they get empty. Ships with extreme customisation so that you can create the perfect system for your server!
temp_vc.title: {animated} Voice Channels

default_interface.title: Beautiful interface
default_interface.description: Astro ships with a beautiful default interface which makes it easy for mobile users to manage their private channel!

custom_interface.title: But also customisable
custom_interface.description: Astro interfaces are fully customisable down to the last pixel, make it look exactly how you need, imagination is your only limit!

voice_role.description: Astro can assign or remove a role when a user joins a specific voice channel! This way you can, for example, let people see gaming text chats only while they are in a gaming VC, imagination is your only limit!

clear_cache.description: If you are encountering weird issues with temporary voice channels, especially when the incremental names for the channels start with a wrong number or skip some, hit this button, otherwise try to avoid this!

voice_roles.title: Voice roles
voice_roles.description: Voice roles allow to give temporary roles to users inside specific voice channels!
voice_roles.channel_description:
Channel that triggers this voice role. If you select a category, all channels of that category will trigger this voice role.
If you select a generator, all temporary voice channels generated from it will trigger this voice role.
voice_roles.role_description: This role will be applied when a user joins the channel selected above
voice_roles.action_description: Assign means Astro will give the role to the user when he joins the channel and remove it when he leaves. Remove does the opposite. Toggle behaves like 'Assign' if the user doesn't have the role, 'Remove' otherwise
voice_roles.permanent_description: If enabled, Astro will not revert the action when the user leaves the channel
voice_roles.ultimate_required: Ultimate is required to have more than 1 voice role. Upgrade your server to Ultimate to create more voice roles.
voice_roles.delete_confirm_title: Are you sure you want to delete the voice role?
voice_roles.delete_confirm_description: This action cannot be un-done and you wont be able to restore this voice role!

vc_name.title: Name
vc_name.description: The default name that temporary voice channels have when created

locked_name.title: Locked name
locked_name.description: The name that temporary voice channels have when locked

hidden_name.title: Hidden name
hidden_name.description: The name that temporary voice channels have when hidden

state_change.title: State change
state_change.description: Whether the voice channel name should be update when the state of the voice channel changes. For example when the user locks or hides the channel

owner_change.title: Owner change
owner_change.description: Whether the voice channel name should be update when the owner changes

activity_change.title: Activity change
activity_change.description: Whether the voice channel name should be update when the activity of the owner changes. For example when the owner stops playing a game

renaming.title: Renaming
renaming.description: Whether the voice channel name should be updated even if it was manually renamed by the owner. For example, if this setting is off and the owner renames the channel, it wont be updated when any of the above scenarios happen

category.title: Category
category.description: The category in which temporary voice channels are generated

position.title: Position
position.description: The exact position where temporary voice channels are placed inside the category.

user_limit.title: User limit
user_limit.description: The user limit, or 0 for no user limit

bitrate.title: Bitrate
bitrate.description: The bitrate in kbps, leave empty for using your Discord server default bitrate

inheriting.title: Inheriting
inheriting.description: Choose if temporary voice channels inherit permissions from the generator, the category in which they are generated, or if they should not inherit any permissions

default_state.title: Default state
default_state.description: Whether the temporary voice channel should be locked or hidden upon creation

target_role.title: Target role
target_role.description: Astro will modify the permissions of this role when needed, for example when a user locks or hides the channel

moderator_role.title: Moderator role
moderator_role.description: This role will always have permissions to manage the channel, even when the channel is locked or hidden

min_user_limit.title: Minimum user limit
min_user_limit.description: The minimum user limit users are allowed to set for their temporary voice channel, 0 means no limit

max_user_limit.title: Maximum user limit
max_user_limit.description: The maximum user limit users are allowed to set for their temporary voice channel, 0 means no limit

min_bitrate.title: Minimum bitrate
min_bitrate.description: The minimum bitrate, in kbps, users are allowed to set for their temporary voice channel

max_bitrate.title: Maximum bitrate
max_bitrate.description: The maximum bitrate, in kbps, users are allowed to set for their temporary voice channel

owner_permissions.title: Owner permissions
owner_permissions.description: Select the Discord permissions a voice channel owner has over its temporary voice channel

owner_role.title: Owner role
owner_role.description: This role will be given to temporary voice channel owners

queue_mode.title: Queue mode
queue_mode.description: When enabled, Astro will first move users into existing temporary voice channels if available. If there are no temporary voice channels available, it will create a new one

fallback.title: Fallback generator
fallback.description: If this generator reaches the limit of temporary voice channels (Discord allows a maximum of 50 voice channels per category), Astro will move the user to this generator as fallback

waiting_auto.title: Automatic waiting room creation
waiting_auto.description: When enabled, Astro will automatically create a waiting room for temporary voice channels upon creation

waiting_name.title: Name
waiting_name.description: The default name for waiting rooms

waiting_category.title: Category
waiting_category.description: The category in which waiting rooms are generated

waiting_position.title: Position
waiting_position.description: Whether waiting rooms should be generated above or below their corresponding temporary voice channel. Or at the bottom of the category

waiting_user_limit.title: User limit
waiting_user_limit.description: The user limit for waiting rooms

waiting_inheriting.title: Permissions inheriting
waiting_inheriting.description: Choose if waiting rooms inherit permissions from the generator, the category in which they are generated, or if they should not inherit any permissions
